name: tinker-bilibili-downloader
description: Bilibili Video Downloader Plugin for TINKER

tinker.name: Bilibili Downloader
tinker.description: Download Bilibili videos with quality selection

zh-CN.name: B站视频下载
zh-CN.description: 下载哔哩哔哩视频，支持画质选择

query.description: Parse a Bilibili video URL and return title, pages, and available quality options. Call this before download. Updates the plugin UI.

download.description: Start downloading the video previously queried via query. Returns immediately with taskIds; use get_progress to poll status. Optionally set quality, pages, and downloadPath.

quality.description: Quality id from query.qualityOptions (e.g. 80 for 1080P). Defaults to the currently selected quality.

pages.description: Page/episode numbers to download from query.pages. Defaults to the currently selected pages.

downloadPath.description: Absolute directory for this download. Falls back to the path set in the plugin UI when omitted.

get_progress.description: Get download progress. Pass taskId for one task, or omit it to list all tasks.

taskId.description: Task id returned by download. Omit to list all tasks.
